item.tib: rdzogs pa chen po nam mkha' spyi gcod kyi rtsis byang
item.coloph: de ltar le'u brgyad du bzhugs pa 'di ni/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i snyan rgyud/ rag shi rgyal mtshan ye shes kyis zhu ba phul nas shel le rgya skar gnas su yi ger btabs nas/ bka' yi gdams pa gnas der 'chad pa'o/ bkra shis so//
